THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.K. SAHOO THE HON'BLE MISS JUSTICE SAVITRI RATHO Order No. ORDER 11.03.2025 0 1 . T h i s m a t t e r i s t a k e n u p t h r o u g h H y b r i d a r r a n g e m e n t ( v i d e o conferencing/physical mode).
Heard Mr.B.C. Ghadei, learned counsel for the petitioners and Miss.S.Devi, learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.

This writ petition has been filed by the petitioners-Santosh Kumar Mohapatra, Santan Mohapatra,
Saramani Mohapatra and Jayanti Lenka with a prayer to set aside the order dated 30.12.2024 (Annexure -1) with a further prayer to direct the Opposite parties to pay the compensation to the petitioners for acquiring their land on the basis of the valuation report dated 20.12.2024 (Annexure-5).

However, learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission to withdraw this writ petition to file Santosh Ku. Mohapatra vs State Of Odisha And Others ..... ... on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22078057/
1 appropriate application in terms of section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 before the Collector, Mayurbhanj (opposite party no.2).
